notablePrerequisites:
Elvish Guidance attached to a Forest you control.
Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four Elves.
description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the Forest that has Elvish Guidance attached.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Elvish Guidance triggers, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
